In this context, liver biopsy findings are more likely to show intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile duct destruction rather than other specific changes such as lymphoplasmacytic and eosinophilic infiltration of portal tracts or granulomas. The evidence paths support the association between these medications and drug-induced liver disease, reinforcing the possibility of bile duct destruction on liver biopsy.
